## What it is

Slide-in 16x16 pixel isolation egg-crate baffle (`10.0 mm` pitch, `8.8 x 8.8 mm` cell openings, `8.5 mm` deep) for the BTF-LIGHTING 16x16 WS2812B LED matrix (`B01DC0IOCK`). It slides into `matrix_16x16_housing` right over the flexible PCB to hold the PCB flat against the backplate and isolate every 5050 RGB LED into its own crisp `10 x 10 mm` square pixel with zero light bleed into neighboring cells. Its flat top surface forms the rear support plane for the `162 x 162 mm` Akamino polycarbonate diffuser sheet.

## Design notes

- `10.0 mm` center-to-center pixel pitch across all 16x16 cells (`160.0 x 160.0 mm` active array).
- `1.2 mm` internal divider walls (exactly 3 perimeters with a 0.4 mm nozzle) leave an `8.8 x 8.8 mm` cell opening over each `5.0 x 5.0 mm` 5050 SMD LED package (`1.9 mm` clearance per side).
- `1.8 mm` outer perimeter rim gives a `162.4 x 162.4 mm` outside envelope that slides smoothly inside the `163.0 x 163.0 mm` track of `matrix_16x16_housing` (`0.3 mm` clearance per side) while stepping over the `161.0 x 161.0 mm` PCB pocket shelf (`0.7 mm` bearing ledge per side) and staying captive behind the `158.8 x 158.8 mm` front bezel (`1.8 mm` retention overlap per side).
- Prints flat on the Creality CR-10 bed (`300 x 300 mm`) with zero supports and zero bridges.

## Don't

- Don't fuse the baffle permanently to the backplate while the front diffuser bezel also overhangs the perimeter: keeping the baffle as a separate slide-in insert lets the `160 x 160 mm` flexible PCB drop in first, the baffle slide in second to clamp the PCB flat, and the `162 x 162 mm` polycarbonate diffuser slide in third.
- Don't thicken `grid_wall` past `2.0 mm` — that shrinks the pixel aperture and blocks oblique light spread before it reaches the diffuser.
- Don't chamfer the bottom face or the internal cell walls (`1.2 mm` dividers cannot carry a 1 mm chamfer).

```toml
[part]
min_wall = 1.2
```
